sections.heading: Build your startup’s website in a day, not a sprint.
body: A launch page, pricing, a waitlist form and a blog, with the CRM and email behind them, on one platform. Describe the site and Aglyn AI drafts it; edit it on the canvas; ship on your domain. Start free and grow into a team.

sections.heading: Questions about a website builder for startups.
body: What the free plan covers, how far the platform scales and what engineers can extend.

items.title: Can I launch a landing page and waitlist for free?
items.body: Yes. The free plan covers a site with up to five pages and forms; the waitlist lands in your Inbox, and from Starter in the CRM.

items.title: Will we outgrow it?
items.body: The same platform runs a hundred sites with roles, versioning and an API, so the marketing site, docs, pricing and blog can stay in one place as you grow.

items.title: Can engineers extend it?
items.body: Yes — and most startups never need to. Aglyn is open source with a REST API and plugins, so engineers can extend it when the product demands it.

items.title: Does it handle pricing pages and docs?
items.body: Yes. Pricing, documentation, blog and the marketing site all run on the same platform and theme.

items.title: Can I email the waitlist?
items.body: Yes. Campaigns to consented contacts are part of Marketing on Pro and up, and a workflow can send the confirmation the moment someone signs up.

items.title: Can Aglyn AI write the first version?
items.body: Yes. Describe what you are launching and who it is for, and Aglyn AI drafts the pages, navigation, form and palette for you to edit.

items.title: What is Aglyn?
items.body: Aglyn is a website builder with the store, forms, CRM, email, analytics and Aglyn AI built in. It is open source and free to start.

sections.heading: Build your startup on Aglyn.
body: Free to start — get your site live today and add the rest as you grow.
